CAP_AM meets Monday/Wednesday, 8:00–9:15 a.m.; CAP_ALT meets Tuesday/Thursday, 8:00–9:15 a.m. Either schedule totals 12 credits, within your required 12–16 credits.

CAP_ALT is feasible: it fulfills CAP4000, you completed its CS3000 prerequisite, one seat is available, and it conflicts with neither your other courses nor your Tuesday/Thursday noon–5 p.m. work hours. Both sections meet in the morning, so neither satisfies your afternoon-class preference, which is a preference rather than a hard rule.

Your approved schedule—KEEP_A, KEEP_B, and CAP_AM—remains unchanged.
